resource: VIS-2 light fields 11-12 of one Player or Creature entry in a world spatial snapshot or delta (capability 19 WORLD_LIGHT_V1)
allocation_impact: The light adds at most 6 bytes to an entry (two tagged varints of at most 255), so the largest entry stays within its existing bound and a full 256-entry lit snapshot within the snapshot payload bound; light-only updates count against the same 256-entry ceiling. A light change is sent at most once per 1,000 ms per entity; a change inside that interval is held, not queued. Malformed, zero, over-255, repeated or misplaced light fields fail closed. Non-durable.
boundary_tests: max=6: crates/protocol-oteryn/src/world_spatial_entities.rs light_is_carried_only_under_capability_19_on_players_and_creatures (a maximum light adds exactly 6 bytes)
